digest.component_or_area: LLM verification pipeline (verifier models & review kernel)
propositions: Pydantic tolerant parsing can normalize divergent provider/model output into structurally valid but semantically empty verification results, which must not be treated as valid review outcomes
Semantically empty responses (raw-empty or malformed-to-empty after reshape) must route to indeterminate or contract-failure via pass3_decide's no-verification rule, not pass/fail decisions
Verification telemetry must separately count clean parses, recovered non-empty parses, semantically empty outcomes, and unrecoverable responses via outcome_counts buckets
Pipeline-level wiring to emit outcome_counts telemetry from verify_findings into plan_review_decide and code_review_decide step-functions remains incomplete
Flexible normalization and bounded self-healing of provider/model output variation must remain provider-independent and deterministic without schema rigidity
Kernel-level acceptance criteria and unit tests for verify_findings are shipped; follow-up ticket c2c5-53a7-2ce0-4d98 tracks pipeline consumer wiring
